Transcending classic design elements with eye-catching appeal, the American Custom Stratocaster draws the most discerning players as the embodiment of elegance and perfectly alluring playability. An NOS lacquer finish lets the two-piece select ash body breath and resonate with each note. The one-piece 3A roasted flame maple neck has a 10/56 “V” profile, 9.5” radius and 22 narrow tall (6105) frets for exceptionally comfortable play in all registers.

Custom Shop hand-wound ’64 pickups (with reverse-wound/reverse-polarity middle pickup) are connected to a five-way switch and Fat ’50s wiring for strong tone with transparent bloom on each note. Other features include a single-ply gold anodized aluminum pickguard, Custom Shop vintage synchronized tremolo, Sperzel® die-cast tuning machines with white pearloid buttons, bone nut and American Standard string tree. Includes deluxe hardshell case, strap and certificate of authenticity.

Innovation Meets Heritage — The Deluxe Strat Plus

The 1992 Fender American Deluxe Strat Plus is a standout model from Fender's era of rapid technological advancement. Positioned as a premium alternative to the standard Stratocaster, the Deluxe model offered a high-end wood configuration and a specialized "power" set of Lace Sensors. According to data from Fuzzfaced and StratCollector, these guitars were designed for the professional player who demanded superior tuning stability and a wider tonal palette without the noise of traditional single-coils.

This particular unit comes in the rare and stunning Blue Frost finish, perfectly complemented by a snappy Maple fingerboard. It is a "noiseless" workhorse that captures the high-performance boutique quality of early '90s Fender.


Key Features & Professional Specs

  • Premium "Sandwich" Body: Constructed with an Ash top and back over an Alder core. This provides the balanced, classic resonance of Alder with the visual beauty and added "pop" of an Ash outer layer.
  • Lace Sensor "Blue/Silver/Red" Trio: This configuration is designed for maximum versatility:
  • Neck: Blue Lace Sensor (Warm, 50s humbucker-style tone).
  • Middle: Silver Lace Sensor (Fat, 70s-style single-coil sound).
  • Bridge: Red Lace Sensor (High-output, hot bridge tone for lead work).
  • TBX Tone Circuit: The Treble Bass Expander (TBX) control for the middle and bridge pickups goes beyond a standard tone knob. It acts as a specialized EQ that can cut or boost frequencies, offering a significantly wider tonal range.
  • Unmatched Stability: Built for precision performance with a Wilkinson Roller Nut and Schaller Locking Tuners. These features, combined with the Deluxe 2-point Synchronized Tremolo, ensure incredible tuning stability even with heavy vibrato use.
  • Fast Playability: The Maple neck features a comfortable "C" shape profile, a 9.5" radius, and 22 medium jumbo frets for effortless bends and smooth lead lines.

Product Details

  • Body Material Ash Top/Back over Alder Core
  • Finish Color Blue Frost
  • Neck Profile Maple, "C" Shape (Polyurethane Finish)
  • Fingerboard Maple
  • Radius 9.5" (241 mm)
  • Frets 22 Medium Jumbo
  • Pickups Lace Sensor Blue (N), Silver (M), Red (B)
  • Controls Master Volume, Neck Tone, TBX Tone Control (M/B).
  • Switching 5-Way Blade Selector
  • Nut Wilkinson Roller Nut
  • Bridge Deluxe 2-point Tremolo w/ Pop-in Arm
  • Tuners Schaller Locking Tuners


The Lace Sensor technology eliminated the traditional 60-cycle hum while the Wilkinson nut and locking tuners solved the age-old Strat tuning issues. It remains one of the most reliable and versatile professional tools Fender ever produced." — Referencing data from Fuzzfaced & StratCollector.

description:
Fender American Standard Stratocaster Special Edition — 2009 — Seafoam Green / Matching Headstock

The 2009 American Standard was a strong moment for the model — updated bridge with a copper-infused high-mass block, BiFlex truss rod, hand-rolled fingerboard edges, and a thinner urethane undercoat for improved body resonance. This particular example is a Fender Special Run from that year: Seafoam Green with a matching painted headstock, a combination produced for 2009 only and not part of the standard lineup. These have become genuinely sought-after for players who want an American Standard with a little more visual character than the catalogue colours offered.

The alder body carries the Seafoam Green finish well — a colour Fender has periodically revisited since the early '60s, and one that looks as good in person as it does in photos. The three American Standard Alnico V single-coils are wired through Fender's Delta Tone system, which includes a high-output bridge pickup and a no-load tone control on the middle and bridge positions — effectively removing the tone circuit from the signal path at full rotation for a cleaner, more direct sound.

Condition is near mint. Includes the original Fender/SKB hardcase.
